perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.description: Greatly increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Perfect Float
enhanced.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Triple Tap
enhanced.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Keep Away
enhanced.description: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

enhanced.name: Lucky Shot
enhanced.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves for an improved duration.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

enhanced.name: Firing Line
enhanced.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Under Pressure
enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Cascade Point
enhanced.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

enhanced.name: Eye of the Storm
enhanced.description: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.

enhanced.name: Explosive Payload

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

enhanced.name: Mega Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.
